automation_evidence.quote: Our system deploys three specialized LLM agents including a Statistical Analyst, a Physics Interpreter, and a Meteorology Expert that generate domain-specific textual gradients from weather time series observations.

metric_evidence.quote: On average across backbones, WeatherTGD achieves an LLM judge overall quality score of 8.50/10, representing a +1.49 improvement over the best baseline

summary: Replaces human caption writing for weather series with a training-free multi-agent refinement loop; it scores higher than six multi-agent baselines on LLM-judge and human-expert ratings, with component ablations, but targets no named time series obstacle.
